The passphrase may be empty to indicate no passphrase (host keys must have an empty passphrase), or it may be a string Of arbitrary length. A passphrase is sinilar to a password, except it can be a phrase with a series Of words, punctuation, numbers, whitespace, or any string of characters you want.
